If you are coming from Jira, think of Confluence as the place where your team captures context: plans, meeting notes, how-to guides, decisions, whiteboards, and shared knowledge. Jira tracks the work; Confluence explains the work. What to know first Confluence and Jira are connected. You can paste Jira work item links into Confluence and view useful details without leaving the page. Navigation goes both ways. When Jira work is linked to a page, the page details panel can show related Jira work items, making it easier to move between tools. Confluence is organized into spaces. A space is a team area for documentation, project content, and shared knowledge. You can create multiple content types. Common options include live docs, pages, whiteboards, databases, and smart links. It is intended to help leaders, admins, business users, developers, architects, and enablement teams understand where Summer 26 advances Salesforce capabilities and which innovations are most likely to deliver near-term business value. Focus of Summer 26: broader orchestration across agents, stronger Slack-centered execution, more operationalized AI experiences, improved industry workflow coverage, and deeper governance for enterprise-scale AI. Executive summary Summer 26 shifts from individual AI-assisted features toward a more connected agentic operating model . The release makes Slack a more explicit engagement layer, strengthens multi-agent orchestration, simplifies self-service and setup experiences, and expands the practical controls required to govern AI across enterprise workflows. Where Spring 26 emphasized broad enablement of AI in product areas, Summer 26 places heavier emphasis on: Orchestration: coordinating multiple agents and tools rather than relying on isolated assistants. page_content: paths are defined. Change management: users may struggle if Slack, CRM, portals, and AI workflows all change simultaneously. Governance load: more connected tools and agents increase the need for permissions, logging, testing, and policy enforcement. Data trust dependency: conversational and autonomous experiences will underperform if source data remains fragmented or poorly governed. Recommendation: do not treat Summer 26 as a broad feature activation exercise. Use it to intentionally design a governed agent ecosystem with clear user journeys, trusted data, and defined control points. Bottom line Summer 26 is a more strategic and operationally mature AI release. Its distinguishing strengths are multi-agent orchestration , Slack-centered execution , self-service simplification , and enterprise AI control-plane maturity . Organizations ready to connect data, workflows, and collaboration surfaces will get the most value from this release.
